name: Chiara Siracusa
description: '''Chiara Siracusa''' (born 25 September 1976), often known [[mononym]]ously as '''Chiara''', is a Maltese singer who represented her country in the [[Eurovision Song Contest]] in [[Eurovision Song Contest 1998|1998]], [[Eurovision Song Contest 2005|2005]], and [[Eurovision Song Contest 2009|2009]].
